elements_selected.content: Implement ^block-id and [[Page^block-id]] resolution to Merkle leaves per REQ-042b and REQ-042c. Local block-id resolution (^block-id form): scan the source file's MerkleLeaf vec for a Paragraph or other leaf whose normalised content ends with '^block-id' (the Obsidian block-id syntax). The scanner already tracks WikiLink.block_ref — extend this to also record ^block-id annotations as part of MerkleLeaf metadata (add Option<String> block_id field to MerkleLeaf). During scan, when a paragraph or block-level element ends with ' ^identifier', extract the identifier and store it as the leaf's block_id. Resolution: find the leaf with matching block_id in the target file → return its ContentHash. Cross-file resolution ([[Page^block-id]] form): 1) Resolve the page name using standard wikilink matching, 2) Find the target file's leaf with matching block_id. For both forms, if not found: return an error (not a drift diagnostic — a static validation error). Implement in src/merkle.rs. Store resolved target_leaf_hash in ResolvedTarget.
